CFPBootstrap.method: Exact dyadic CFP inputs; exact-integer Racah coefficients enclosed by Arb; validated projector and Gram residuals; spectral-gap-one projection and polar-normalization perturbation bounds. No floating residual is used as a proof bound.

method: Independent exact-factorial Clebsch–Gordan contractions and exact-integer Racah swap coefficients with Arb enclosures; complete recursive CFP-character validation; rigorous projector/polar perturbation bounds; outward-rounded dyadic inverse-Cholesky congruence residuals including CFP error. No naked floating-point eigenvalue is used.
statement: There is no pure fifth-order anticoherent state on21 symmetric qubits. Consequently all orders at least5 are excluded; the explicit fourth-order witness proves the maximum is exactly4.
